```renyi
public function parse_command(arguments: List of Text) returns Command
  purpose: Turn command-line words into a command; anything unrecognized is Help.
  example: parse_command(["add", "buy", "milk"]) is Add(task: "buy milk")
  example: parse_command(["done", "2"]) is Done(position: 2)
  example: parse_command([]) is Help

  let command be arguments.first() otherwise return Help

  if command is "add" then
    let words be arguments.drop(1)
    if words.is_empty() then
      return Help
    end
    return Add(task: words.join(" "))
  otherwise if command is "done" then
    if arguments.length() is not 2 then
      return Help
    end
    let text be arguments.at(1) otherwise return Help
    let position be text.to_integer() otherwise return Help
    let parsed be Done(position: position) otherwise return Help
    return parsed
  otherwise if command is "show" then
    if arguments.length() is 1 then
      return Show
    end
    return Help
  otherwise
    return Help
  end
end
```

```renyi
public function parse_command(arguments: List of Text) returns Command
  purpose: Turn command-line words into a command; anything unrecognized is Help.
  example: parse_command(["add", "buy", "milk"]) is Add(task: "buy milk")
  example: parse_command(["done", "2"]) is Done(position: 2)
  example: parse_command([]) is Help

  let verb be arguments.first() otherwise return Help

  if verb is "add" then
    let words be arguments.drop(1)
    if words.is_empty() then
      return Help
    end

    let task be words.join(" ").trim()
    if task is "" then
      return Help
    end

    return Add(task: task)
  otherwise if verb is "done" then
    if arguments.length() is not 2 then
      return Help
    end

    let text be arguments.at(1) otherwise return Help
    let position be text.to_integer() otherwise return Help
    let command be Done(position: position) otherwise return Help
    return command
  otherwise if verb is "show" then
    if arguments.length() is not 1 then
      return Help
    end

    return Show
  otherwise
    return Help
  end
end
```

```renyi
public function parse_command(arguments: List of Text) returns Command
  purpose: Turn command-line words into a command; anything unrecognized is Help.
  example: parse_command(["add", "buy", "milk"]) is Add(task: "buy milk")
  example: parse_command(["done", "2"]) is Done(position: 2)
  example: parse_command([]) is Help

  let word be arguments.first() otherwise return Help

  if word is "add" then
    let task_words be arguments.drop(1)
    if task_words.is_empty() then
      return Help
    end
    return Add(task: task_words.join(" "))
  otherwise if word is "done" then
    if arguments.length() is not 2 then
      return Help
    end
    let position_text be arguments.at(1) otherwise return Help
    let position be position_text.to_integer() otherwise return Help
    return Done(position: position) otherwise Help
  otherwise if word is "show" then
    if arguments.length() is not 1 then
      return Help
    end
    return Show
  otherwise
    return Help
  end
end
```
